proposed_capability: One welcoming startup entry with mode-specific save targets, current Windows process identity, and durable explicit operator/agent fallback evidence.
player_save_control_impact: Dev uses already authorized household-bound disposable identities with existing local screen gates. Production targets trusted recency evidence within the explicit production mode and records the missing approved effect route. Active games and pending certifications take precedence. No save edits, process termination, injected tooling, or automatic authentication.
expected_outcome: Bound process instances, route eligible dev and observed production candidates, dispatch at most one calibrated dev path when admitted, and persist actionable host gaps.
negative_tests: Reject reused PID and new PID when comparing a previous process.
Keep active certification and existing open game.
No generic Resume, protected dev save, unverified recency or cross-instance evidence.
Record human/agent fallback with before, during, after evidence.
rollback_path: Revert launcher/source commits, keep local receipts and all player game files.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact Windows game and calibrated local lab availability.
Trustworthy production latest-played observation and approved same-slot effect adapter on the installed game.
